name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-04-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
